pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding using three different methods: in-sink food disposer (Badger 9 model, 0.75 cm strainer hole size), manual meat grinder with medium extrusion plate (1.0 cm), and manual meat grinder with small extrusion plate (0.5 cm). For the disposer treatment, 500 g of standard food waste was flushed through the disposer using 500 mL of deionized (DI) water, resulting in a 1:1 mixture. For the meat grinder treatments, 500 g of food waste was coarsely chopped and then fed through the grinder. Ground samples were mixed by hand to obtain 10 g representative wet weight (ww) samples. A control assay measured the release of endogenous SCOD by diluting the mechanically ground food waste with a buffered aqueous solution. An enzyme assay measured enzymatic hydrolysis of the mechanically ground food waste in the presence of excess hydrolytic enzymes in a buffered aqueous medium.
